Swamp fever strikes the poorest people of Venore, and {npc:Ottokar}, at the city's asylum, fights it with pouches of medicine. While the fever spreads, {creature:Feverish Citizen|Feverish Citizens} appear around the city and may drop pieces of cloth for the {wiki:Afflicted Outfits Quest|Afflicted Outfits}. If you bring {item:Medicine Pouch|Medicine Pouches} to Ottokar, you receive bags with the belongings of the sick, which may contain {item:Slug Drug} to tame a mount.
Swamp Troll Cave entrance (south of Venore)
